scripts.lint: oxlint && pnpm --dir packages/dms-marketing/frontend-vue lint && node packages/dms-marketing/scripts/check-locales.mts && node packages/dms-marketing/scripts/check-dms-components.mts &&node packages/dms-marketing/scripts/check-docs-module-version.mts
scripts.typecheck: pnpm --filter @antelopejs/interface-dms-marketing typecheck && pnpm --filter @antelopejs/dms-marketing typecheck && pnpm --dir packages/dms-marketing run typecheck:layer
scripts.prepare: if [ -e .git ] && command -v git >/dev/null 2>&1 && command -v lefthook >/dev/null 2>&1 && GIT_DIR=.git GIT_WORK_TREE=. git rev-parse --git-dir >/dev/null 2>&1; then GIT_DIR=.git GIT_WORK_TREE=. lefthook install; fi
